description: This file is a shell script designed to automate the cloning, configuration, compilation, and installation of various CCSP components such as CcspCommonLibrary, TestAndDiagnostic, webui, hal, ccsp-psm, and ccsp-p-and-m on a Raspberry Pi platform. It defines a function execute_component that handles different components based on input parameters and manages building processes for each component, including cloning from Git repositories, running autoreconf, configuring with specific build options, and make install commands.

methods.name: execute_component
methods.description: Main function controlling the cloning, configuring, building, and installing of specific CCSP components based on passed arguments.
